verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਾਏ ਗਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabadhai sabadh milaiaa gurmukh aghaR ghaRaae gahanaa|

en.bdb: Gurumukh (Angad) attuning his sabad (word) to the Sabad has chiselled his clumsy mind to make it an ornament.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਖਲਹਲੁ ਖਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhai bhagat bhai chalanaa aap ganai na khalahal khahanaa|

en.bdb: He has disciplined himself in the fear of loving devotion and losing the sense of ego has saved himself from all sorts of imbroglios.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਦੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਸ ਨਸੀਨੀ ਬਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: dheen dhunee dhee saahibee gurmukh gos naseenee bahanaa|

en.bdb: Achieving mastery over spirituality as well as temporarily, the gurmukh has resided in the loneliness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਛਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaaran karan samarath hai hoi achhal chhal a(n)dhar chhahanaa|

en.bdb: Even being cause of all effects and all powerfull he remains in the world full of deceptions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath veechaar sahaj ghar ghahanaa|

en.bdb: Dopting truth, contentment, compassion dharma, richness and scriminatory wisdom(Vichar) he has made peace his abo

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਛਡਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਹੁ ਤਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaam krodh virodh chhadd lobh moh aha(n)kaarahu tahanaa|

en.bdb: Shedding lust, anger and opposition he has repudiated greed, infatuation and ego.
Such a worthy son Lahana (Angad) is born in the family of Baba (Nanak).
